name: Breaking News
description: Breaking stories for the top of a screamsheet.

results.text: Megabuilding fire in Watson | Fire crews are still fighting a blaze that started on the 40th floor of a Kabuki megabuilding before dawn. Residents say the sprinklers never came on. Trauma Team has been seen on the roof twice.
Maglev derails over Santo Domingo | An NCART car left the rail during the evening rush. Rescue drones are pulling passengers out now; NCART says sabotage "can't be ruled out".
Cyberpsycho loose in the Glen | MaxTac has closed six blocks around the Glen's central plaza. Witnesses describe a full-borg in a sanitation uniform. Stay indoors.

Corporate Plaza in lockdown | Security barriers are up at every entrance to the Plaza after shots were heard in a tower lobby. No company has commented. Netrunners report the local CitiNet node is dark.
Blackout across Heywood | Power is down from the Glen to Vista del Rey. The grid operator blames "an unscheduled load event". Looting is reported on Jackson Plains.
Bomb at the Pacifica pier | A device went off near the old pier just after midnight. The Voodoo Boys deny any part in it. Two dead, nine hurt.
AV down in City Center | A corporate AV came down onto a street market below the Plaza. Its markings were stripped off before the press arrived.
Arroyo's water poisoned | Residents of Arroyo are told not to drink from the taps until further notice. Bottled water prices tripled within the hour.
Gang war spills into Japantown | The Tyger Claws and a rival crew traded fire through a crowded night market. The NCPD says it is "monitoring the situation".
Netrunners take down city services | Traffic lights, transit boards and emergency dispatch went dark across three districts for forty minutes. Every screen showed the same message: WE SEE YOU.
Hostages taken at a Kabuki clinic | Armed people are holding staff and patients inside a ripperdoc's clinic in Kabuki. Their demands haven't been made public.
Militech convoy hit on the Badlands road | A military convoy was ambushed east of the city. The nomad clans are blaming each other, and Militech isn't saying what was in the trucks.
